tools.name: prism_health
tools.description: Check whether the stable Prism STDIO bridge and its local browser service are ready. Does not start a browser profile.

tools.name: prism_get_connection_status
tools.description: Return structured local service connection state and whether automatic recovery is available.

tools.name: prism_start_service
tools.description: Open Prism Browser when necessary and wait for the local AI service to become ready.

tools.name: prism_restart_service
tools.description: Restart only the Prism local AI service and reconnect this STDIO session without changing the client configuration.

tools.name: prism_create_profile
tools.description: Create one closed profile without opening a browser. Requires Pro and the user-enabled Allow AI to create profiles setting. Name, proxy, group, tags, startUrls, fingerprint and kernelVersion are optional; omitted values use Prism defaults and a fresh fingerprint seed; OS version, CPU cores and scree

tools.name: prism_create_profiles
tools.description: Create 1–50 profiles in one request, all validated before saving: if any profile is invalid nothing is created and error.details names each field (profiles[i].field). No browsers are started. Uses the same options, Pro permission, user creation toggle and 24-hour requestKey protection as prism_creat

tools.name: prism_list_profiles
tools.description: List browser profiles allowed by the user’s global MCP policy and individual profile overrides.

tools.name: prism_create_task_session
tools.description: Create an independent page-control workspace for one authorized profile. Use one task session per agent task.

tools.name: prism_list_task_sessions
tools.description: List only task sessions owned by this MCP connection.

tools.name: prism_close_task_session
tools.description: Release one task page controller without closing the browser profile or another agent task.

tools.name: prism_get_profile_status
tools.description: Get safe lifecycle metadata for one AI-enabled browser profile.

tools.name: prism_start_profile
tools.description: Start one AI-enabled browser profile through the normal Prism security checks.

tools.name: prism_close_profile
tools.description: Close one AI-enabled browser profile and persist its local browser data.

tools.name: prism_open_page
tools.description: Start an AI-enabled profile if needed and open one HTTP or HTTPS URL in a new browser tab.

tools.name: prism_read_page
tools.description: Return a stable paginated accessibility snapshot. Interactive elements and iframe containers include a rounded CSS viewport rect when available (rect:null otherwise; use prism_get_element_rect for the exact rect and quad); iframe containers are actionable:false. Coordinates use the selected top-leve

tools.name: prism_get_text
tools.description: Read visible text from the selected page, including same-origin frames and open shadow roots, or from one element ref. Form values, including passwords, may be returned.

tools.name: prism_get_attribute
tools.description: Read one named DOM attribute from an element ref without executing caller-supplied JavaScript.

tools.name: prism_get_markdown
tools.description: Convert the selected page, same-origin frames and open shadow roots into bounded Markdown for efficient AI reading.

tools.name: prism_get_table
tools.description: Read a table by element ref or zero-based page index and return caption, headers and rows.

tools.name: prism_get_list
tools.description: Read a list by element ref or zero-based page index and return ordered state and item text.

tools.name: prism_find
tools.description: Find accessible page elements by text, role, value, placeholder or URL and return current actionable refs.

tools.name: prism_get_page_schema
tools.description: Return headings and counts for links, controls, forms, tables, lists, frames and open shadow roots.

tools.name: prism_navigate_page
tools.description: Navigate the currently selected task page to an HTTP or HTTPS URL and verify the resulting state.

tools.name: prism_go_back
tools.description: Go back in the selected task page history and verify the resulting page state.

tools.name: prism_go_forward
tools.description: Go forward in the selected task page history and verify the resulting page state.

tools.name: prism_reload_page
tools.description: Reload the selected task page, optionally bypassing the HTTP cache.

tools.name: prism_hover_element
tools.description: Scroll an element into view and move the page mouse pointer to its center.

tools.name: prism_scroll_element_into_view
tools.description: Scroll the selected task page until an element ref is visible.

tools.name: prism_select_option
tools.description: Select and verify one or more values in a native HTML select element.

tools.name: prism_press_keys
tools.description: Press a page-level shortcut such as Meta+A, Control+Enter, Shift+Tab or Alt+ArrowLeft. Optional durationMs holds it before release (0–15000 ms); it does not synthesize auto-repeat.

tools.name: prism_handle_dialog
tools.description: Accept or dismiss the currently open alert, confirm or prompt dialog; prompt text is supported.

tools.name: prism_take_full_page_screenshot
tools.description: Capture the complete selected page up to bounded safe dimensions.

tools.name: prism_wait_for_stable
tools.description: Wait for document complete, no in-flight network requests, network idle and DOM quiet.

tools.name: prism_wait_for_element
tools.description: Wait until an element matching accessible text, role, value, placeholder or URL appears and return fresh refs.

tools.name: prism_wait_for_text
tools.description: Wait until visible page text appears, including same-origin frames and open shadow roots.

tools.name: prism_wait_for_url
tools.description: Wait until the selected page URL contains or exactly equals the requested value.

tools.name: prism_wait_for_download
tools.description: Wait for a task page download to complete and return its safe filename and byte counts.

tools.name: prism_list_network_requests
tools.description: List the task session network ring buffer. Authorization, Cookie, Set-Cookie and common URL token values are redacted before storage.

tools.name: prism_get_network_request
tools.description: Get one sanitized request and response. Text/JSON body retrieval is optional and limited to 1 MB; binary bodies are omitted.

tools.name: prism_start_har
tools.description: Start a bounded sanitized HAR capture for this task session.

tools.name: prism_stop_har
tools.description: Stop and return the bounded sanitized HAR captured by this task session.

tools.name: prism_set_offline
tools.description: Enable or disable CDP offline emulation for the selected task page.

tools.name: prism_list_pages
tools.description: List controllable website tabs and visible browser-extension pages in one authorized profile. Use this after a wallet connection opens a popup.

tools.name: prism_select_page
tools.description: Switch subsequent read, click, type, screenshot, key and scroll operations to one target returned by prism_list_pages.

tools.name: prism_wait_for_page
tools.description: Wait for and select a matching website tab or wallet/extension popup. Omit text filters to select the newest target of the requested kind.

tools.name: prism_take_screenshot
tools.description: Return a PNG of the visible viewport for visual inspection when the accessibility snapshot is incomplete, including wallet extension pages.

tools.name: prism_click_element
tools.description: Click one element using a temporary ref. The result separately reports whether the input event was sent, the element received a trusted click, observable state changed, or verification timed out; it also reports newly opened targets.

tools.name: prism_click_and_wait_for_page
tools.description: Click an element, wait for a new matching website tab or wallet/extension popup, then select it for subsequent operations.

tools.name: prism_set_checked
tools.description: Reliably set and verify a native checkbox/radio or ARIA checkbox/radio/switch. Returns the previous and final state and fails if the page did not change it.

tools.name: prism_set_input_files
tools.description: Set explicitly named local files on a file input or its associated upload button/drop area without opening the system picker. Only absolute regular non-symlink paths outside sensitive system locations are accepted.

tools.name: prism_type_text
tools.description: Type text into an editable element ref. Authorized page reads may return current form values, including password fields; entered text is not written to the Prism audit log.

tools.name: prism_click_and_hold
tools.description: Hold a mouse button or a touch contact, then release. Provide a fresh element ref OR CSS viewport x/y. Default: 3000 ms, left mouse button, stationary pointer. Ref targets are scrolled into view and pressed only where the referenced element itself is on top: a covered or clipped target fails with EL

tools.name: prism_drag
tools.description: Press at from, move to to over durationMs, then release. Each endpoint is a fresh ref OR CSS viewport x/y. Both endpoints must already be visible; use prism_scroll_element_into_view first if needed. Ref endpoints are checked before pressing (ELEMENT_OBSCURED / ELEMENT_NOT_VISIBLE). Defaults: 600 ms,

tools.name: prism_get_element_rect
tools.description: Get a fresh CSS-pixel rect and quad for an element ref. Coordinates are relative to the selected top-level viewport, including cross-origin frame offsets. Does not scroll. Re-measure after scrolling, resizing or layout changes. Hidden or stale elements fail explicitly.

tools.name: prism_click_point
tools.description: Click CSS viewport coordinates from the latest Prism screenshot. Prefer prism_click_element when an element ref is available.

tools.name: prism_scroll_page
tools.description: Scroll the visible website or extension page by CSS-pixel deltas. Positive deltaY scrolls down.

tools.name: prism_press_key
tools.description: Press Enter, Tab, Escape, Space, Backspace, Delete, an arrow key, Home, End, PageUp or PageDown in the selected website or extension page. Optional durationMs holds the key before release (0–15000 ms), without auto-repeat.

tools.name: prism_wait
tools.description: Wait briefly before reading the page again, for a navigation or dynamic update to settle.
